claim.statement: OpenCode's current security policy explicitly says the local assistant is not sandboxed, that its permission system is a usability control rather than a security boundary, and that users needing isolation should run it inside an operating-system sandbox, container or virtual machine.

source.title: OpenCode Security Policy
source.locator: Security model; local execution; no sandbox; permissions; container or VM isolation guidance

limitations: This is a publisher-declared limitation, not an independent security assessment; no isolation or permission enforcement was tested.
unknowns: The host platform, user privileges, external sandbox or container configuration, filesystem mounts, network restrictions and effective isolation are unknown.
